visual_action: The video displays two consecutive still images. The first shows Donald Trump seated and holding a signed document, surrounded by other men in suits. The second image shows Barack Obama smiling while seated and signing a document, surrounded by a group of people including Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the main subject of the first image and is named in the on-screen text: 'Physically here as Trump kicks 17 million Americans off their healthcare'.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: He is the main subject of the second image, shown smiling and signing a document, presented as a positive contrast to Trump.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Visible in the background of the photograph with Barack Obama.

cast.name: Nancy Pelosi
cast.evidence: Visible standing behind Barack Obama in the second photograph.

on_screen_text.text: Physically here as Trump kicks 17 million Americans off their healthcare

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; the audio consists only of a song.
audio_music: The video features the song 'Bad Habit' by Steve Lacy throughout. The melancholic and yearning tone of the song, with lyrics like 'I wish I knew you,' reinforces the nostalgic feeling for the Obama era implied by the visuals.
editing_pacing: The video is a static slideshow consisting of two still images with text overlays.
cultural_references: The song 'Bad Habit' by Steve Lacy.
The 'Physically here / Mentally here' meme format.
central_claim: Donald Trump's policies stripped healthcare from 17 million Americans, a destructive act contrasted with the positive legacy of the Obama administration.
intended_effect: To evoke nostalgia for the Obama era and generate fear or anger towards Donald Trump's healthcare policies, encouraging support for Democrats.
